 Amen Thompson (knee) is questionable for Wednesday’s matchup with the Pacers. 
 Thompson sat out Monday’s loss to the Heat, but he’s got a chance to return following that one-game absence. If Thompson is cleared to take the court, Tari Eason would likely shift back to the bench. 
 Tari Eason 
 HOU 
 Forward 
 #17 
 Tari Eason finished Monday’s loss to the Heat with seven points (2-of-8 FGs, 3-of-3 FTs), seven rebounds, three assists and one steal. 
 After hitting three three-pointers and scoring 25 points in Sunday’s win over the Wizards, Eason’s production dropped significantly on Monday. The Rockets forward, starting for Amen Thompson (knee), missed all four of his three-point attempts against the Heat. The rebounds and assists were solid, but fantasy managers likely hoped to get more out of Eason than this. 
 Kevin Durant 
 HOU 
 Forward 
 #7 
 Kevin Durant accounted for 22 points (8-of-19 FGs, 4-of-4 FTs), two rebounds, three assists, one block and two three-pointers in Monday’s loss to the Heat. 
 Durant shot 2-of-6 from beyond the arc against the Heat, but still extended his run of games with at least 20 points to seven. He attempted 19 shots against the Heat, one shy of his season high, with Amen Thompson’s absence leading to more attempts for the future Hall of Fame forward. Fantasy managers may not be thrilled to see KD take a back seat to Houston’s younger scorers, but the approach may raise the Rockets’ ceiling in terms of contending for a title. 
 Tari Eason 
 HOU 
 Forward 
 #17 
 Fred VanVleet, Tari Eason, Kevin Durant, Jabari Smith Jr. and Alperen Şengün will start Monday’s game against the Heat. 
 The Rockets won’t have Amen Thompson for Monday’s game, as he’s been sidelined with a sore left knee. Eason moves into the starting lineup, which raises his fantasy ceiling. Reed Sheppard should also have more opportunities to contribute, as the Rockets are also without Marcus Smart (suspension).

 Amen Thompson (knee) is out for Monday’s game against the Heat. 
 Sidelined due to a sore left knee, Thompson played 29 minutes in Sunday’s win over the Wizards. His absence frees up opportunities for Tari Eason and Reed Sheppard, with one likely moving into the starting lineup.

 Amen Thompson (knee) is questionable for Monday’s matchup with the Heat. 
 Thompson is dealing with left knee soreness, and it could keep him sidelined for the second leg of a back-to-back set. If Thompson is ultimately ruled out, Tari Eason could replace him in the starting lineup, with more minutes available for Reed Sheppard. 
 Amen Thompson 
 HOU 
 Guard-Forward 
 #1 
 Amen Thompson recorded a team-high 26 points (9-of-11 FGs, 5-of-6 FTs), seven rebounds, seven assists, one steal and one block over 29 minutes to power the Rockets to a 147-119 blowout win over the Wizards on Sunday. 
 Thompson had a real shot at a triple-double on a night where Houston shot nearly 60 percent from the floor, including 45 percent (15-of-333) from three-point range to cruise to a nearly 30-point victory. He scored 19 first-half points and broke the 20-point threshold for the first time since October 28. He’s still not a threat from three-point range, but he did knock down a season-high three of them in this one. He’s managed to deliver early-round fantasy value this season, averaging 15.8 points, 7.0 rebounds, 3.4 assists, 1.1 steals and 0.7 blocks through 14 games. The Rockets have a three-game week on tap that features road tilts against the Heat, Pacers and Nuggets. 
 Tari Eason 
 HOU 
 Forward 
 #17 
 Tari Eason compiled a season-high 25 points (10-of-14 FGs, 2-of-3 FTs), seven rebounds and one assist over 30 minutes off the bench in Sunday’s win over the Wizards. 
 Eason got some additional run with Houston opening up a massive cushion in this one and he managed to cross the 20-point threshold for the first time this season. He shot 71 percent from the floor, including 3-of-5 from three-point range, and chipped in seven rebounds as well. He’s more of a fringe fantasy option than anything else, but he’s capable of taking advantage of favorable matchups like this one. 
 Tari Eason 
 HOU 
 Forward 
 #17 
 Tari Eason scored 14 points (6-of-13 FGs), 11 rebounds, two assists, and two 3-pointers in win over the Jazz on Friday. 
 Eason got the minutes over Jabari Smith in this game, and he was wreaking havoc in this one. He was in the dunker spots and taking advantage of the Jazz’s lack of a high-level big man defender. It’s not a sign to add Tari Eason but more of a reassurance that he is still a good streamer if you’re looking for rebounds with the potential for a good game. 
 Amen Thompson 
 HOU 
 Guard-Forward 
 #1 
 Amen Thompson recorded 19 points (8-of-11 FGs, 3-of-5 FTs), seven rebounds, four assists, one steal and two blocks in Wednesday’s win over the Warriors. 
 Thompson remains a valuable fantasy option, especially for managers willing to punt three-pointers. However, his scoring average has decreased by more than three points per game compared to last season. Thompson’s ability to fill a stat line has preserved most of his value. However, he’ll need to be a more productive scorer to live up to his top-25 ADP.

 Mitchell’s run of excellent play continued against the Bucks Wednesday.  It continues to be the Wagner show for the Magic with Paolo Banchero (hamstring) still sidelined.
